facts.fact: Mamadou Alpha Diallo says a legal framework exists in the 2016 law on cybersecurity and personal data protection, whose personal-data part is little respected and largely not implemented.
facts.system: 2016 law on cybersecurity and protection of personal data

facts.fact: Mamadou Alpha Diallo says the law provides for an independent data protection authority that has not yet been set up in Guinea.
